proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Checked the field status at 7 and it said limited, come before ten. We got there at 8:15 with three kids and still filled a flat. That little tag saved our Saturday.
reviews.name: Juniper A.

reviews.text: The freezer math was right. A half fit in our 15 cubic foot chest with room left for ice packs, just like it said it would.
reviews.name: Wendell R.

reviews.text: Blueberry picking in a Mississippi June is no joke. They open at seven, the rows are mowed, and there is a water cooler in the shade of the pecan tree.
reviews.name: Shonda L.

reviews.text: Brown eggs with a few blue ones, always a date on the carton. Our toddler calls it the chicken farm and asks every Thursday.
reviews.name: Mattie G.

reviews.text: Came for pumpkins in October and left with pork chops, a quart of honey and a wagon ride. Prices on the stand matched what we saw online. No surprises at the table.
reviews.name: Augustin P.

reviews.text: I texted Corinne on a Sunday to ask about blackberries. They were a week out, and she said so plainly instead of letting me drive from Pearl for nothing.
reviews.name: Ida F.

proof.guarantee: If the site says the field is open and you find it picked out, your next bucket is on us.
